notes: All three passive benefits encode cleanly. The AC formula (base 15 + DEX mod) uses modify_ac_set_base gated by the unarmored EquipmentPredicate, split into its own passive part via CompositeMagicItemMechanics. Magic Resistance uses the existing saveSourceFilter on modify_roll_advantage. War Mage uses modify_save_dc (+2) and modify_roll_numeric on spell_attack_roll (+2). The SavingThrowSourceFilter type was already in the surface with the note 'Robe of the Archmagi's Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects', confirming this was an anticipated encoding.
